The concentrated formula features PHYTO PDRN derived from Korean ginseng to help support elasticity and a healthy-looking moisture barrier while delivering an instant dose of hydration. Its fine mist makes it easy to layer into your routine or reapply throughout the day whenever skin needs more moisture, bounce and glow. 3.38 fl oz/ 100 ml

products.name: PDRN Reedle Shot 100
products.description: VT Cosmetics pairs its signature Reedle technology with vegan PDRN derived from Korean ginseng to help visibly refine, firm and revitalize skin. The micro-sized Reedle technology creates a distinctive tingling sensation as you apply it, while PDRN, niacinamide and propolis help support elasticity, tone and a healthy-looking skin barrier. Use it as the first treatment step in your routine for skin that looks smoother, plumper and more radiant. 1.69 fl. oz. / 50 ml

products.name: VT Collagen Reedle Shot 100
products.description: A daily collagen booster that helps restore firmness, bounce, and lasting hydration. Powered by VT’s Cica Reedle™ technology, this serum uses micro reedle structures to enhance ingredient delivery and improve absorption for visibly plumper, smoother skin. Formulated with low molecular weight collagen, milk protein extract, and vitamin E, it helps refine texture, improve elasticity, and maintain balanced moisture. The refreshing, non-sticky texture melts into skin for a supple, revitalized feel with every use. Designed for daily care, it leaves skin looking hydrated, lifted, and firm with a natural, healthy glow. 1.69 fl oz/ 50ml

products.name: VT PDRN Cream 100
products.description: A rich yet lightweight cream that deeply hydrates, soothes, and restores bounce for a visibly firmer, radiant complexion. Powered by 100,000 ppm of Phyto PDRN™ derived from Korean wild ginseng, this formula helps improve elasticity and strengthen the skin barrier for lasting resilience. Micro azulene capsules melt into skin on contact, delivering a calming burst of hydration while 5-Ceramide Complex, panthenol, and hyaluronic acid replenish and lock in moisture. Skin feels soft, smooth, and nourished with a healthy, glass-like glow. Fragrance-free and gentle enough for sensitive skin, it layers perfectly under makeup or as a comforting night cream for a luminous, supple finish. 1.69 fl oz/ 50 ml

products.name: VT PDRN Essence 100
products.description: A vegan glow-boosting essence that firms, hydrates, and restores elasticity for visibly smoother, more radiant skin. Powered by 100,000 ppm of Phyto PDRN™ derived from Korean wild ginseng, this innovation delivers rejuvenating care that helps improve firmness and resilience. The milky, fast-absorbing texture instantly plumps and hydrates while strengthening the moisture barrier with ceramides and panthenol. With continued use, skin appears firmer, brighter, and refreshed with that glass-like luminosity K-beauty is known for. Fragrance-free and gentle enough for sensitive skin, it’s the perfect post-Reedle Shot companion or a stand-alone step for daily radiance and resilience. 1.01 fl oz/ 30 ml

products.name: VT Reedle Shot 100
products.description: A viral K-beauty favorite that refines texture, boosts radiance, and helps skin look smoother and more even every day. This daily booster uses VT’s Cica Reedle™ technology with micro-sized mineral particles to gently activate the skin’s surface and enhance ingredient absorption for visibly refined results. Formulated with centella asiatica, triple hyaluronic acid, and propolis extract, it hydrates, soothes, and strengthens the barrier while improving the look of pores and uneven tone. The lightweight texture leaves a subtle tingle that signals it’s working, revealing a clearer, glass-like finish with continued use. Apply as your first step after cleansing to prep skin and maximize the benefits of everything that follows. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive. 1.69 fl oz/ 50ml

products.name: VT Reedle Shot 300
products.description: A potent, microneedle-inspired booster for smoother, more even skin. Designed for use every three days, this concentrated treatment helps refine uneven tone and texture while boosting radiance over time. Powered by VT’s Cica Reedle™ technology, it uses micro-sized mineral particles to gently activate the skin’s surface and enhance absorption for visible results. Soothing centella asiatica, triple hyaluronic acid, and propolis extract work together to calm, hydrate, and strengthen the barrier, leaving skin soft, balanced, and luminous. Stronger than the daily Reedle Shot 100, this treatment delivers targeted care that helps reset skin clarity and glow with each use. Apply after cleansing as your “Step Zero” to prep for the rest of your routine. Suitable for most skin types, including sensitive. 1.69 fl oz./ 50 ml

products.name: VT Reedle Shot 50
products.description: The viral microneedle-inspired serum that’s redefining skincare routines everywhere. This cult favorite uses VT’s signature Reedle™ technology with microscopic reedle structures that gently activate the skin’s surface to boost absorption, smooth texture, and reveal visibly refined, balanced skin. The lightweight formula leaves a soft tingle on contact as cica and propolis work to calm, hydrate, and strengthen the skin barrier. Over time, skin feels smoother, clearer, and more resilient with that fresh post-facial glow. Use morning or night before essence or moisturizer to maximize results. Loved across Korea for its instant payoff and long-term benefits, it is gentle enough for sensitive skin yet powerful enough to live up to the hype. 1.69 fl oz/ 50ml

products.name: VT Reti-A Reedle Shot 100
products.description: A retinol-infused serum that smooths texture, refines pores, and boosts radiance with every use. This advanced formula combines VT’s Cica Reedle™ technology with Reti-A, a blend of retinol, bakuchiol, and vitamin A, to gently resurface and brighten the skin’s appearance. Micro reedle structures help deliver active ingredients more effectively, while Cicahyalon™ soothes and hydrates to balance the skin. The lightweight emulsion texture absorbs easily, leaving skin soft, refined, and visibly more even. Best used in the evening. For sensitive skin, start a few times per week and increase as skin adjusts. 1.69 fl oz/ 50ml
